title: Spatial Cognition
summary: Transforms FRIDAY from 'I see objects' into 'I understand the environment': object permanence, location, spatial relationships, movement, room structure, user position, and change. A persistent Scene Graph stores relationships (not pixels); a tracker maintains persistent object identity; a relationship engine, room model, user localizer, spatial memory, and query engine complete the picture. All cross-subsystem communication goes through the M16 service layer (dependency injection) — the spatial engine imports no other subsystem's internals.
philosophy: Humans remember relationships, not pixels. Store: phone ON desk, BESIDE keyboard, INSIDE office, last seen 09:34, confidence 96%.

service_layer.rule: Beginning with M16, subsystems communicate ONLY through services obtained from a ServiceContainer (DI). No subsystem imports another's internals.

components.scene_graph: persistent SceneNode tree (UUID, object_class, label, parent, children, position, relationships, confidence, created/updated/last_seen, room, session, persistent_id); SQLite write-through
components.tracker: persistent identity across frames: NEW/TRACKED/MOVED/LOST/RETURNED/REMOVED; greedy one-to-one match (no duplicate ids); long sessions
components.rooms: extensible RoomModel (never hardcoded names); camera->room map + injectable classifier plugin
components.memory: SpatialMemory (SQLite): meaningful events (object/room/relationships/timestamp/confidence/session) + movement history; redundancy-suppressed; Chronicle forward via MemoryService
components.queries: backend reasoning: where_is / last_seen / what_changed / which_room / what_moved
components.engine: SpatialEngine orchestrator (rooms -> tracker -> scene graph -> relationships -> localization -> world model -> memory -> events)

inputs.name: SpatialObservation
inputs.shape: {object_class, label, confidence, position{x,y}, bbox?, camera_id, room?, track_id?, stable_id?, source, ts}

deployment: no hardcoded paths (DB resolves to project root unless configured)
public_api: snapshot() / poll(camera_id?) / save() / load() / set_camera_room(cam, room)
start() / stop() / dashboard() / metrics() / health() / manifest() / attach(runtime)
invariants: subsystems communicate ONLY through services (no internal imports, no circular deps)
every object keeps ONE persistent identity (no duplicate ids)
the engine never raises (a spatial fault cannot crash the Cognitive Core)
relationships are recomputed + diffed; only changes are published/persisted
redundant spatial events are suppressed before memory
no hardcoded paths or room names; everything configuration-driven
no global state in the service container; full dependency injection
